title: 第8210章 成为焦点第8209章 陆群
content_zh:
虽然陆安是陌生人，但因为有元令，谁都不会怠慢。顿时所有人都围上来，全部都笑脸相迎，对陆安十分亲和客气，丝毫没有对陌生人的架子。
陆安自然礼貌回应，行礼道，“见过各位前辈。”
“前辈？哈哈！我们也是很久没有听过同境界这么称呼了！”有人大笑道，“不过拿到元令要在四十岁之前，而且听说你今年二十六岁，还不到二十七岁，当真如此吗？”
“是，但也快二十七岁了。”
“嘶……”
“二十六岁，还有奇异的能量，两者加起来才能拿到元令，当真是少年英豪啊！”
“是啊！”
“小兄弟，能不能看看你的能量啊！”
一群人起哄，吵吵闹闹，自然有人会说出这样的话来。
若是只有几个人，这样的话不好说出口，会显得很冒犯。但这么多人，就完全不一样了。
“是啊！”
“能不能看看啊？”
一时之间不少人都这么说，所有人都看着陆安，不知道陆安有何反应。
陆安有些犹豫，并没有立刻回答，但数息之后说道，“可以。”
顿时，众人眼睛大亮！
“好！”
“小兄弟果然敞亮！”
“我们拭目以待！”
众人喧闹，陆安没有理会，释放能量，顿时身前出现一个多色球体。
这多色球体，与给核心长老展示的一模一样，没有任何区别。

所有人立刻定睛去看，生怕错过一点细节。他们都发现这个多色球体的不简单，因为内部蕴含数不清特殊的能量和规则。而这些能量和规则又互相不融合，却又能如此稳定，极其诡异，令这些人都看呆了！
很多人都倒吸一口气，不敢相信自己的眼睛！他们都想要多看一会，但陆安没有给这个机会。
陆安只将能量释放一息，便立刻消散。
所有人看着这一幕，不由得身体一震，只觉得完全意犹未尽！
他们舍不得，想多看！
他们意识到，这多色球体中一定蕴含多个世界的力量。
不过他们当然不可能真的让陆安再次释放出来，他们的情商没有这么差劲。毕竟他们更重要的目的是结交这样一位拥有元令的天才青年，而不是要得罪对方。正因如此，就算心里再痒，也没有人提出再释放一次。
“不愧是拥有元令的人！当真令人大开眼界！”
“是啊！”
“这能量，我前所未见、前所未闻！”
“小兄弟，快请坐！”
陆安完全被众人簇拥坐下，所有人都将陆安围起来，陆安成为庭院完全的焦点和中心。
“听说小兄弟已经成亲了？”有人问道。
毕竟陆安和李涵是一同遇到楚天殿的三个人，消息传开很正常。
“是。”陆安回答。
“我们还听说，你的妻子也十分厉害？”又有人大声问。
“是。”陆安点头，“她的天赋不在我之下。若她想要得到元令，轻而易举。”
content_en:
Although Lu An is a stranger, because of Yuan Ling, no one will neglect him. Immediately everyone gathered around and greeted Lu An with smiles. They were very friendly and polite to Lu An, without showing any airs towards strangers.
Lu An naturally responded politely and saluted, "I have met all of you, seniors."
"Senior? Haha! It's been a long time since we've heard someone from the same realm call you that!" Someone laughed, "But you have to get the Yuan Ling before you are forty years old, and I heard that you are twenty-six years old this year, not twenty-seven years old. Is that really true?"
"Yes, but he is almost twenty-seven years old."
"Hiss..."
"Twenty-six years old, and still has strange energy. The two combined can get Yuan Ling. He is really a young hero!"
"Yes!"
"Little brother, can you see your energy?"
A group of people were making noise and making noise, so naturally someone would say something like this.
If there are only a few people, such words are difficult to say and may appear offensive. But with so many people, it's completely different.
"Yes!"
"Can I take a look?"
Many people said this for a while, and everyone looked at Lu An, wondering how Lu An would react.
Lu An hesitated and did not answer immediately, but after a few breaths he said, "Okay."
Suddenly, everyone’s eyes lit up!
"Okay!"
"Little brother is really open-minded!"
"We'll see!"
The crowd was making noise, but Lu An ignored it and released his energy, and a multi-colored sphere suddenly appeared in front of him.
This multi-colored sphere is exactly the same as the one shown to the core elders, without any difference.
Everyone immediately looked intently, for fear of missing any details. They all discovered that this multi-colored sphere was not simple, because it contained countless special energies and rules. And these energies and rules are not integrated with each other, but they can be so stable and extremely weird, which makes these people stunned!
Many people took a breath and couldn't believe their eyes! They all wanted to watch it for a while, but Lu An didn't give it a chance.
Lu An only released the energy for one breath, and then it dissipated immediately.
Everyone looked at this scene and couldn't help but feel their bodies trembled, feeling that they still had something to say!
They were reluctant to part with it and wanted to see more!
They realized that the multi-colored sphere must contain the power of multiple worlds.
But of course they can't really let Lu An be released again. Their emotional intelligence is not that bad. After all, their more important purpose is to make friends with such a talented young man with Yuan Ling, rather than to offend him. Because of this, no matter how itchy their hearts were, no one proposed to release it again.
"As expected of a man with Yuan Ling! It's really eye-opening!"
"Yes!"
"This energy is something I have never seen or heard before!"
"Little brother, please sit down quickly!"
Lu An was completely surrounded by everyone and sat down. Everyone surrounded Lu An, making Lu An the complete focus and center of the courtyard.
"I heard that my little brother is married?" someone asked.
After all, Lu An and Li Han were the three people who met Chu Tiandian together, so it was normal for the news to spread.
"Yes." Lu An replied.
"We also heard that your wife is also very powerful?" someone asked loudly.
"Yes." Lu An nodded, "Her talent is not inferior to mine. If she wants to get Yuan Ling, it will be easy."
